title: Covariate-Balancing-Aware Interpretable Deep Learning Models for Treatment Effect Estimation
reasoning: The paper mentions 'ethical concerns' in the introduction regarding the collection of observational data, but this is a brief mention within the context of explaining the motivation for using observational data over experimental data.
